newsitem.title: USA: Clinton raises $1 million for Democrats.
newsitem.headline: Clinton raises $1 million for Democrats.

text.p: President Clinton Wednesday night attended a political fundraiser that generated $1 million for Democratic Senate candidates, including the re-election bid by Sen. Carol Moseley-Braun of Illinois.
"We have changed the way politics works in Washington," Clinton said in delivering an appeal for more Democrats in Congress. "It drives some people crazy but we're doing it."

After the speech, Clinton left with first lady Hillary Rodham Clinton for Hope, Ark., where they will attend funeral services Thursday for Henry Oren Grisham, 92, the president's great uncle who died Monday.
Billie Paige, the campaign treasurer for Moseley-Braun, said the Senate Democrat hoped to receive about $100,000 from the fundraiser, which attracted about 250 contributors.
